# Root candidate: operator-polymer positivity of a quantum inverse-noise state

1 November2026. New proposed supporting mechanism. NOT an efficient preparation algorithm, not a completed loader. Independent review required.

## A. Finite matrix-gas zero-free lemma
Let finitely many polymer operators A_gamma be Hermitian, with [A_gamma,A_eta]=0 whenever gamma and eta are compatible. Define the matrix gas
 Z(S)=sum_{compatible Gamma subset S} product_{gamma in Gamma} A_gamma,
including identity for empty Gamma. Suppose positive mu_gamma satisfy
 ||A_gamma|| product_{eta in N[gamma]}(1+mu_eta) <= mu_gamma,
where N[gamma] is the closed incompatibility neighborhood (including self).

Claim: every Z(S) is invertible and
 ||Z(S)^(-1) Z(S\{gamma})|| <=1+mu_gamma.
Proof by induction on |S|. Write B=S\{gamma}, C=B\N(gamma). The exact deletion identity is Z(S)=Z(B)+A_gamma Z(C). Compatibility gives [A_gamma,Z(C)]=0. Thus
 Z(S)=Z(B)[I+Z(B)^(-1)Z(C)A_gamma].
Deleting the neighbors of gamma successively telescopes Z(B)^(-1)Z(C) into ordered products of smaller inverse-deletion ratios. Its norm is at most product_{eta in B∩N(gamma)}(1+mu_eta). The displayed closed-neighborhood condition bounds the perturbation in brackets by mu_gamma/(1+mu_gamma)<1. Neumann inversion proves the claim. No commutation among incompatible operators is needed.

Scale all A_gamma by a common real t∈[0,1]. The same bound applies, every Z_t(S) is Hermitian and invertible, and Z_0(S)=I. Eigenvalues cannot cross zero, so Z_1(S)>0. The argument is finite-dimensional and uniform in total volume once rooted activity bounds establish the local condition.

## B. Application candidate: weakly noncommuting Gibbs state plus independent Pauli noise
Let H_ref be a sum of commuting bounded finite-range terms (the actual code H0 plus bounded onsite bath terms). Let V=sum_a V_a be bounded-degree weak local Hermitian perturbations. Fix finite beta and finitely many bounded-support physical Pauli conjugations P_i(.)P_i, with bounded patch overlap. The actual target is the FULL joint Gibbs operator G=exp[-beta(H_ref+V)], including the bath. Independent noise acts only on the accessible chosen memory spins.

The relative operator U=exp(beta H_ref/2) G exp(beta H_ref/2) has a Duhamel connected-component expansion. Since H_ref terms commute, imaginary-time conjugation of each V_a enlarges its support only by reference

# Operator-gas scope clarification

The independent receipt accepts the actual stabilizer H0 plus onsite bath reference, with memory-only Pauli noise. In that case the reference and its Pauli conjugate commute, so the stated local energy-change bound controls the similarity transform.

For a broader arbitrary commuting reference with non-Pauli local terms, use the SAFE bound B=2 sum of norms of reference terms incident on the fault support. Do not replace it by ||H_ref-P H_ref P|| without additional commutation. The independent receipt and executable counterexample preserve this distinction.

The positive quantum preimage theorem still supplies no preparation algorithm, bath access or logical-input fidelity. Sector-conditioned references and dimer constructions are separate exploratory interfaces, not a completed protected noisy memory.

# Root construction: preserve conserved bath charges rather than demand canonical reweighting

1 November2026. Conditional stationary-reference extension, not a preparation algorithm.

Suppose the actual Hamiltonian is block diagonal in conserved classical bath labels b:
 H = direct_sum_b H_b,
with logical Pauli operators acting only on memory and identically in each block. Suppose every conditional H_b satisfies the same static rare-bad-syndrome estimate p_b<=p_n and the same local commutator bound/correctability premises, uniformly in b. Each H_b may include a uniformly weak local noncommuting memory perturbation.

For ANY supplied probability distribution pi_b, define
 sigma = direct_sum_b pi_b exp(-beta H_b)/Z_b.
This is stationary under the ACTUAL Hamiltonian, whether or not pi_b equals the canonical bath weights Z_b/sum Z_b. No operation needs to change a conserved bath charge to make this reference stationary.

For a logical Pauli Q, relative entropy decomposes blockwise:
 D(Q sigma Q || sigma)=sum_b pi_b D(Q rho_b Q || rho_b).
The sector weights and log partition constants cancel. Thus the same 2 beta v n p_n bound holds, followed by the logical twirl and reference-safe exact-H storage estimate. Logical overwrite retains the physical bath-label distribution automatically. A bath-marginal obstruction to the canonical FULL Gibbs state is therefore not by itself an obstruction to the MEMORY CAPABILITY.

This does not erase the central preparation problem: one must prepare the correct conditional memory state for the actual b, or prove a weaker sufficient admission for a reachable state. Reading b may be impossible without an admitted interaction/measurement service; knowing its distribution is not the same as knowing its realization. Coherent superpositions between sectors require a separate argument and are excluded here.

A trivial coupling through stabilizers alone would make the logical algebra commute with H on the full Hilbert space; it is not a consequential substitute for generic damaging interactions. Any proposed conditional sampler or physical preparation must retain nontrivial logical-error mechanisms and charge controls, spectroscopy, cooling and residual faults.
